tbesh_html:
1) to look at or to, regard, gaze at or about
1a) (Qal) to gaze at, regard, behold, look about
1b) (Hiphil) to look away, cause gaze to turn away
1c) (Hithpael) to look in dismay, gaze about (in anxiety)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered
strongs_1890.kjv_def: depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.
